summary: Execute final system closure in one owner-authorized phase: tenant entry, accounting workspace, complete general-tourism lifecycle, production frontend builds, secure platform backup/recovery, API hardening, deployment evidence, regression and UAT readiness.
protectedReason: Owner-authorized final system closure includes the canonical tenant-entry redesign from email credentials to company-scoped Username + temporary password, enforced first-login password rotation, self-service credential maintenance, and additive migration/backfill. Platform Core remains the sole identity owner; SaaS only resolves Company Code. Protected navigation changes expose the approved account-credentials page without duplicating identity truth.
publicApiBreakingReason: Owner-authorized pre-Go-Live tenant authentication contract change: /saas/login moves from Company Code + email + password to Company Code + company-scoped username + password. The staging system is not yet closed/merged for production, and existing database users receive additive backfilled company login identities.
